sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include fondaparinux sodium as of 2026-10-21.

The product label (SPL set 58789e3d) identifies two registered plants: Italfarmaco S.p.A. (FEI 1196) for analysis, labeling, manufacture, and pack, and ScinoPharm Taiwan, Ltd. (FEI 3002840477) for API manufacture.
FDA's most recent inspection of Italfarmaco S.p.A. ended 2023-06-28 and was classified VAI.

FDA's most recent inspection of ScinoPharm Taiwan, Ltd. ended 2026-06-23 and was classified OAI with seven observations including procedures for sterile drug products and validation lacking for sterile drug products.
Corvale East holds 70 syringes at 10.6 per day for 6.6 days on hand; Corvale General holds 327 syringes at 10.7 per day for 30.6 days on hand.

The top-ranked action is to transfer 79 syringes of 7.5 mg/0.6 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East, which would raise Corvale East to 14 days on hand while Corvale General retains two weeks of supply.
Alternate manufacturers Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Limited and Eugia US LLC are not on FDA's shortage list today, but their labels name no plant we could place.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
